title: Havana Cuba
description: An ever-quiet taxi driver meets five different people over the course of one night during Christmas Holidays. An abused runaway wife, a failed actor, an impossible love story of a lower-class young man and two young teenagers making love in the back seat, all come together in this exotic farce of absurd proportions.
